verdict.rationale: The only evidence of acting on many emails at once is Gemini's 'Organize' feature, which can delete multiple emails or add labels on request. That is an AI-assisted route, not direct multi-select of conversations. Filters (gmail-docs-15) apply labels automatically to incoming mail but do not cover user-initiated bulk triage. Missing for 10: evidence of a multi-select UI for conversations, bulk archive, bulk mark-done, one-stroke bulk actions or keyboard shortcuts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
